ratingNote: Top-level ratings use current summaries. goalDifficulty uses reconstructed 48h votes and excludes unfinished review windows.

goalDifficulty.note: Observed historical frequencies, not forecasts. Rating combinations use votes reconstructed at 48h; missing samples and ineligible positions are reported separately. Team observations are correlated with player participations.

comparison.note: Differences can reflect new matches, vote corrections and changed targets. Check conditions and sample sizes before attributing a cause.
